text:
maria: Heads-up: ap-southeast-1 queue depth on llm-large is climbing fast, ~4x normal. Seeing ~700 pending requests across 3 hosts. :warning:
kevin: Details? is this per-model or multi-model?
maria: Per-model — llm-large-prod. Sequence length spike from a batch of long-context agents. avg seq len 1200 -> 6800. KV cache blowup.
yuji: Oncall ran any recent scale test or traffic injection? what's current pool size and pod readiness?
infra-bot: autoscaler: pool=llm-large-prod-apac, target_replicas=12, current_replicas=8, last_scale=14m ago, cpu_util=92%
kevin: We should trigger admission control immediately: reduce per-worker concurrency and fallback to quantized variant (quant8). Sophie can run a controlled rollout.
sophie: I'll start a canary fallback to quantized-llm-large-8bit at 20% traffic. Also temp lower batch_max_tokens to 4000 to prevent massive KV growth.
maria: Can someone patch the rate limiter to 60r/s for the llm-large-prod route? Need immediate relief for tail latencies.
kevin: On it — updating token-bucket config now. Also raising preemption priority for Dedicated customers to preserve their throughput.
oncall-asia: Monitoring dashboards and traces. If backlog stays >500 after 10m we plan: scale pool -> 16 replicas and page infra-sre.
yuji: Quick cost note: adding 8 more GPUs will cost ~ $120/hr. If this pattern repeats we need smarter routing rather than scaling every time.
sophie: Agreed. I'll add a seq_length-based routing heuristic: seq_estimate > 3000 -> route to high-memory nodes or quantized fallback.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for quant8 at 15:03:12 UTC. Traffic shifted to 22% canary.
maria: Backlog down to ~320. Keep observing for next 20m and watch tail latencies. Thanks team :heart:
kevin: Postmortem/action items (quick): 1) implement seq_length routing heuristic 2) autoscaler tuning for bursty seq-length spikes 3) alert thresholds adjust (warn at 200 pending) 4) cost impact analysis for emergency scaleups. I'll open the ticket.
sophie: Assigning to project perf-routing, adding Yuji + Maria as owners.
kevin: Also capture a replay of the offending request traces and a sample of long-context prompts for model team.
maria: Uploading sample logs to the ticket now.
